title: Family conformance manifest
description: One tooling family's declared Practice-operation scripts and gate placement (the Practice's family layer, PDR-143). The manifest is the same bytes in every repository of the family; the host's two placeholder values live in host.json ($defs/host_values). Every item is recomputed against the live tree by the family-conformance validator, a leg of repo-validators:check, at every run. The shapes are strict (additionalProperties false) because the only consumers are the family's own validators: a field the family does not name is a refusal, never a silent pass.

family.description: The tooling family's name; the manifest lives at .agent/family/<family>/practice-operations.json.

scripts.description: Every Practice-operation root package script, name to body. {scope} and {skill_prefix} are substituted from host.json before the body is compared with the live root package.json.

check.description: The skeleton of the root check script as ordered legs: head, then a host slot, then the gates, then a host slot, then tail. A slot holds zero or more of the host's own legs; the family legs must appear exactly, in order, around them.

aggregates.description: Aggregate root scripts, name to the ordered family legs the script must start with; host legs may follow.

hooks.description: Git hook file names under .husky/ that must be byte-identical to the family's copies under .agent/family/<family>/hooks/.

ci.description: The PR-gating workflow and its fan-in job, whose needs must list every other job in the workflow.

compiler_base_flags.description: Compiler options of the root tsconfig.base.json that must be present with exactly these values.

formatter.description: The one formatter configuration file at the root, and the file names that must be absent there.

package_manager.description: The package manager named by the root package.json packageManager field, and its major version.

leg.description: One shell leg of a root script: the text between && separators, trimmed, with host placeholders allowed.

leg_list.description: An ordered, non-empty list of legs.

host_slot.description: A position the host fills with zero or more of its own legs.

host_values.description: The host's values for the manifest placeholders: .agent/family/host.json, the one contextual file in the family directory.

scope.description: The host's package scope, substituted for {scope}.

skill_prefix.description: The host's skill adapter prefix, substituted for {skill_prefix}.
